name: Pen-led line
visual_intent: A dot travels and leaves the line behind it: signatures, flight paths, heartbeats, underlines that start from a full stop.

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: Stroked SVG path (keep transforms on a parent <g>)

parameters.name: ease
parameters.description: Monotonic ease shared by line and dot

parameters.name: dot
parameters.description: Existing circle to use as the tip (default: a created .st-pen-dot)

parameters.name: keepDot
parameters.description: Leave the dot at the end (for a following bloom) or fade it

timeline_requirements.gsap_instance: Timeline passed to Studio.build(builder) (registered as window.__timelines['root'])
timeline_requirements.timing_anchors: Start on the cue that introduces the idea; end where the next beat begins

code_snippet.javascript:
var end = Studio.draw.pen(tl, '#flight', 2.0, { speed: 520 });
Studio.fx.bloom(tl, document.getElementById('flight').__penDot, '#s2', '#s3', end + 0.3);

fallbacks: Studio.draw.stroke without a dot (stroke-draw) when the tip would clutter dense line art.

performance_characteristics.memory_impact: Low; estimate, not measured on the M2

validation.evidence: Runtime self-test tests/studio-runtime/reference-techniques.html in Playwright Chromium on Windows, 2026-10-30.
